name: MLPerf v5.1 Jetson AGX Thor: llama3.1-8b-edge SingleStream TPOT p90 21.64 ms
unit: ms, 90th-percentile time per output token, per query (SingleStream, concurrency 1)
methodology: MLPerf Inference open-division submission, 1x NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor Developer Kit 128GB (unified memory), TensorRT 10.8, CUDA 12.8. Quoted verbatim from performance/run_1/mlperf_log_summary.txt, Result is VALID. v5.1, llama3.1-8b-edge, FP4 weights, SingleStream, concurrency 1. '90.00 percentile time to output token (ns): 21641875' = 21.64 ms. This is the per-token generation latency inside one request, not an aggregate across requests. Mean TPOT on the same log is 21.29 ms.
notes: Open division. Inverse of the p90 is about 46 tok/s per request, but that inverse is not what was measured and is not stored.
